records.label: joy
records.timing_scope: Saved module elapsed measurements. The H3 component sum includes audio_decode+A3+V2+Q_AV only; excludes input preparation, V1, Q_A and Q_V. X07 prediction elapsed_s covers the full recorded multi-route evaluation. Neither is natural-device or streaming response latency. Animation timing is editorial, not recovered module start timestamps.
display_notes: Do not display a seven-class ground-truth label or correctness checkmark. The only annotation is valence.
label and candidate_label are the pre-gate class used for coloring; final_label is the emitted decision. Show final_label=reject when accepted=false.
Preserve the widescreen footage with contain/pad; do not stretch to the portrait ET viewport.
A3, V2 and Q are the true component distributions; H_A and H_V are different fused routes, not component aliases.
